rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"In TypeCollector, two places that read item.DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] are replaced with lookups that return a null location when the member has no source declaration, as happens for members of a type loaded from metadata. The analyzer's report callback is now wrapped so that a diagnostic is only reported when its location is in a syntax tree of the current compilation. The change adds three generator tests that compile a generic struct or record struct into a metadata-only assembly, use a closed form of it as a member, and check that there are no diagnostics and that the resolver is generated.
